items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: The interviewee does not mention DeRica; the mention comes from the interviewer ('I think DeRica. I worked with him a while.')

ctx.x: Oh, I played with two, three brass bands off and on like that. But Donnie D. the trumpet player, you know.
Well, who are some of them? Well, I think DeRica. I worked with him a while. I believe. What about DeJalma Gagne?
Yeah, I worked with Gagne. How often did you play with him? Well, whenever we'd get a funeral parade, they'd get them quite often.
